statement: A fixture that satisfies two independent detector conventions at once cannot guard either: in cejel #405 the first Ruby, PHP and Java fixtures lived in spec/, tests/ and src/test/, so the test-file suffix tokens (_spec.rb, _test.php, Tests.java) could be deleted from repo-signals.ts and the new ecosystem tests stayed green. Only the scratch-mutation run exposed it, three survivors in seventeen. Rule: for each token a guard claims to cover, build a fixture that only that token can recognise, then delete the token and watch the test fail; a mutant that survives for a real reason (here PHP's $this->assert alternative duplicated by assert[A-Z]) is reported as equivalent, not silently dropped.
